title: SubTo Alternatives
h1: SubTo alternatives, by the job you need done
keyLine: SubTo is creative-finance school at a high-ticket price. Buy it only if that is the job.
description: Honest SubTo alternatives: free rental study, cheap memberships, a local attorney, or a full wealth plan. Public $9,800 price, dated sources, who should skip.
answer: SubTo is Pace Morby's creative-finance community. Creative finance here means buying a house in a way that is not a normal new bank loan. One method they teach is buying 'subject to' the seller's existing loan: the loan stays in the seller's name and you take over the payments. That can be legal in some cases. It also carries due-on-sale and title risk, so it is not a beginner toy. The [join page](https://buy.subto.com/) we opened on September 15, 2026 listed the SubTo Accelerator at $9,800, or four payments of $2,450. If you do not want that tactic, pick a cheaper teacher or a different job: rental math, tax, or a written money plan.
criteriaIntro: This is not a clone list. Most 'SubTo alternatives' posts mix other gurus with software. We grouped live education options by job, and we only state prices we could copy from a public page.
criteria: The option teaches real estate, creative finance, or a wider money plan, and we opened a public page for it.
We say the format: free study, cheap membership, high-ticket community, lawyer, or a wealth plan.
Price comes from a public page, or we say it is not published.
We include Legacy Wealth Blueprint and say we sell it.

blocks.heading: What SubTo is
paragraphs: [SubTo's homepage](https://subto.com/) describes a community and training around creative financing. It does not print a checkout price. The [buy.subto.com](https://buy.subto.com/) page we opened listed 'SubTo Accelerator' at $9,800 in full, or four monthly payments of $2,450. It also lists daily Zoom calls, recorded training, documents, and a member-success advisor. Treat those as seller claims. We did not sit in the calls.

The same homepage carries a disclaimer: figures are personal or from clients, results are not typical, and the average person who buys 'how to' information gets little or no result. That is their language, dated to the day we opened the page. It is a reason to slow down, not a reason to copy a testimonial.

You do not need an alternative if you already close normal financed deals and you specifically want this community. You need a different product if you have never underwritten a rental, if you still carry credit-card debt, or if the real pain is tax, not creative paper.

blocks.heading: Alternatives by job
blocks.intro: Start with the job. Then look at price.

items.name: Stay free: forums and podcasts
items.summary: Use [BiggerPockets forums and podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/biggerpockets-real-estate-podcast/id594419649) to learn long-term rentals, house hacking, and basic underwriting at $0. This does not teach subject-to paperwork. It does teach whether a normal rental even makes sense.
items.meta: Job: learn rental math before any high-ticket call

items.name: BiggerPockets Pro
items.summary: Paid tools and forms on top of the free site. A [March 3, 2026 staff post](https://www.biggerpockets.com/forums/48/topics/1280018-new-to-biggerpockets-pro-insurance-and-loan-discounts) said Pro is $32.50 a month billed yearly. See [what to know before Pro](/compare/biggerpockets-what-to-know).
items.meta: Job: calculators and forms, not a mentor

items.name: KenPro (Ken McElroy)
items.summary: Rental and apartment lessons with a public price. [Ken's store](https://kenmcelroy.com/kenprostore/) lists $39.99 a month or $399 a year. Closer to a course library than a creative-finance mastermind.
items.meta: Job: cheap paid lessons on conventional rentals

items.name: BetterLife (Brandon Turner)
items.summary: Coaching and community from a former BiggerPockets host. [BetterLife](https://abetterlife.com/home-2/) did not publish a checkout price on the pages we opened. The Tribe page says it is for people who already did a deal this year.
items.meta: Job: coaching after you already own a deal. Price on request.

items.name: A local real estate attorney plus a normal lender
items.summary: If the job is 'can I take over this loan,' that is legal work, not a Zoom room. A lawyer in the property's state can read the note, the due-on-sale clause, and the title. A lender can tell you whether a new loan is even possible. Fees vary and are rarely on a homepage. This is the adult path when a live contract is on the table.
items.meta: Job: advice on one file. Not a course.

items.name: A fee-only planner or CPA
items.summary: Creative finance does not fix a W-2 tax bill. If the leak is payroll tax or an empty 401(k) match, buy hours from a licensed person. The [FTC](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam) warns that coaching pitches which promise easy real estate profits are often a scam.
items.meta: Job: your tax file or household plan

items.name: Legacy Wealth Blueprint
items.summary: Our 12-month plan for tax, debt, income, investing, and protection. We publish $9,800 cash or card. Same sticker as SubTo Accelerator on the day we checked. Different job. Skip Blueprint if you only want subject-to documents. Details: [Legacy Wealth Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint).
items.meta: Job: one written money plan. We sell this.

blocks.label: Watch for this
paragraphs: Subject-to and seller-finance deals can trip due-on-sale clauses, insurance, and servicing. A community screenshot is not a legal opinion. If a seller rushes you on a recorded call, read the [FTC coaching page](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam) before you pay. Get the total price, refund rule, and who your advisor is, in writing.

blocks.heading: How to choose in 20 minutes
paragraphs: Write one sentence: 'I need help with ___ this quarter.' If the blank is 'my first rental numbers,' stay free or buy KenPro. If the blank is 'this seller will not wait for a new loan,' that is lawyer-plus-lender work, and a $9,800 community may still not close that file. If the blank is 'my tax bill and my debt,' SubTo is the wrong aisle.
bullets: Do not buy SubTo to learn what a cap rate is. Free podcasts cover that.
Do not put a $9,800 coaching bill on a card you cannot pay. The FTC flags that pattern.
Read [coaching vs a course](/compare/real-estate-coaching-vs-course) before any high-ticket call.
If you work full time, see [real estate courses for people with a day job](/blog/best-real-estate-investing-courses-full-time-job).

whoFits: You already understand a normal purchase loan and you can name why you want creative finance, not just the brand.
You can pay $9,800 without carrying new credit-card debt.
You want a map of other live options, including ones we do not sell.
whoSkips: You have not run a simple rental through a calculator yet. Start free.
You need tax, payroll, or debt help. That is a CPA or a wealth plan, not subject-to school.
You want a ranked list of skip-tracing apps. That is software, not this page.

questionsBeforeBuying: What job will this purchase do in the next 90 days that a free podcast will not?
Is the live price still $9,800, and is there a second payment or upsell after I join?
Who reviews my actual contract, and are they a licensed attorney in that state?
What happens to the seller's loan if the due-on-sale clause is enforced?
Send me the refund terms in writing before the call ends.
nextSteps: Run a sample deal in the [rental cash flow calculator](/tools/rental-property-cash-flow) before you pay anyone.
Read [coaching vs a course](/compare/real-estate-coaching-vs-course) if a sales call is already booked.
If tax is the real pain, open [tax strategies for real estate investors](/tax-strategies/for/real-estate-investors) instead of a creative-finance room.

faqs.a: The buy.subto.com page we opened on September 15, 2026 listed $9,800, or four payments of $2,450. The main homepage did not show that number. Check the live checkout. Prices change.

We do not call living brands scams from a homepage. SubTo itself says results are not typical. The FTC says real-estate coaching pitches that promise easy profits and rush the buy are a warning sign. Verify the legal work locally. Do not take our word, or theirs, as a verdict.

faqs.q: What is a cheaper SubTo alternative?
faqs.a: Free BiggerPockets content, then KenPro at $39.99 a month if you want lessons with a published price. Those will not replace a subject-to document set. They cost two orders of magnitude less while you learn whether you even want that tactic.

faqs.q: Is Legacy Wealth Blueprint a SubTo alternative?
faqs.a: Only if your job is a full money plan. It is not a creative-finance community. The cash price we publish is also $9,800. Same sticker, different syllabus. See [Legacy Wealth Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint) and [reviews](/reviews).
